name: Tide Keeper
lore: One of Confluence Foundry’s twin otter keepers, wearing the same copper-trimmed engineer uniform as Spark Keeper. An otter sluice engineer from Confluence Foundry. Water hits mark foes for 3s. Spark Keeper can consume a water mark for a 10-damage discharge in an 85-radius area; the reverse combination works too. Friendly water and lightning fields overlap for one extra 5-damage pulse per water tick. Both heroes work alone.

primary.name: Rivet of Rain
primary.description: A narrow water dart; stops at the first foe or wall. Applies 20% slow for 0.9s and a water mark.

secondary.name: Pocket Sluice
secondary.description: Aim a 95-radius water pool. Four seconds of pulses, water marks and brief slows. Only three fields per hero can exist.

special.name: Grand Waterwheel
special.description: Aim a 145-radius waterwheel that rolls forward at 65 speed for 4s, pulsing every 0.8s. Walls stop its travel. Its water marks combine with friendly lightning.

passive: Sluice Shelter: Your water fields grant you and nearby allies 8% damage reduction while inside.

technique.name: Wide Waterworks
technique.description: Pool radius 125 instead of 95, but pulse damage falls from 8 to 5. Earned by clearing Confluence Foundry in co-op with Tide Keeper and Spark Keeper.

final_technique.name: Rain Harp
final_technique.description: Three water darts in a fan, each 10 damage. Slower firing; more coverage. All can combine with friendly lightning marks.

attack.name: Rain Harp
attack.description: Three 10-damage water darts in a fan.
